prompt: Which country was the first outside of Africa to detect a case of mpox in the most recent outbreak? Note that the first human cases were diagnosed in 1970.
answer: The **United Kingdom** was the first country outside Africa to detect a case in the **2022 global mpox outbreak**. The case was identified in **London on May 6, 2022**, in a traveler who had recently returned from Nigeria.
